reason: Clarify cure periods for payment and technical breaches.

proposed_change.old_text: Defaults limited to non-payment of principal/interest and formal insolvency. A 'cure period' of 15 business days is mandatory for all other technical breaches.
proposed_change.new_text: Defaults should be limited to non-payment after a short payment cure period and formal insolvency; all other technical breaches require at least 15 business days to cure.
